feat(runtime): negative fixture — missing Profile-Impact trailer

This synthetic fixture exercises the negative-path diagnostic. The
trailer block is deliberately incomplete: it carries a valid
Signed-off-by but no Profile-Impact entry at all.

The script must fail this fixture with a diagnostic explicitly
citing the missing Profile-Impact trailer so the commit author can
fix it without guessing.
